title: Refuse a stale modified delta instead of overwriting newer canonical text
description: Refuse a stale modified delta instead of overwriting newer canonical text
acceptance_criteria: A change approved against older contract text never silently overwrites newer text another change put there.
Checking that change stops and names the requirement or section whose text moved.
The project health check (audit) reports the same problem before anything is lost.
The message tells me the way forward: rewrite the change onto the current text and approve it again.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-089/090: an approval that recorded nothing is unknown, not violated, so approvals written before this field keep today's behaviour (Leif chose 'Protect only changes approved from now on'). REQ-change-111: the edited-body refusal still runs first. Never weaken a gate.
